definitions.explanation: Free from worries or stress; relaxed and comfortable.
Describes a situation or condition that requires little effort or responsibility.

examples.japanese: {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしは{気楽|きらく}だ。
{気楽|きらく}に{構|かま}えてください。
{責任|せきにん}がない{立場|たちば}は{気楽|きらく}でいいね。
examples.english: It must be nice having an easy position with no responsibility.
examples.notes: Can have a slightly ironic nuance

notes:
FORMATION:
{気|き} (spirit/mind) + {楽|らく} (comfort/ease)

FORMS:
・{気楽|きらく}な + noun - carefree (modifier)
・{気楽|きらく}に + verb - in a carefree manner (adverb)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{気楽|きらく}に{構|かま}える - to take it easy
・{気楽|きらく}な{暮|く}らし - carefree life
・{気楽|きらく}な{仕事|しごと} - easy job
・{気楽|きらく}に{過|す}ごす - to spend time at ease

NUANCE:
Can be positive (relaxed, comfortable) or slightly negative (irresponsible, not taking things seriously).

SIMILAR WORDS:
・のんき - carefree, easygoing
・{楽|らく} - easy, comfortable
・リラックス - relaxed
